shortDescription: Embrace your affinity for pro-style design and take it all in, from the heavy duty cast iron grates to LED backlit metal knobs. With one turn, you’ll quickly discover this powerful gas cooktop does more than turn heads. The 24k UltraHeat™ center burner has all the heat you need to bring the sizzle yet can instantly drop to a gentle simmer. A total of 5 sealed gas burners including 2 in premium solid brass gives you the flexibility to streamline dinner prep like a pro.

features.text: This is the redesigned LG SIGNATURE. It’s the professional look of pure stainless steel with unexpected touches like solid brass burners. It’s lasting performance combined with high-end innovations that help you create experiences your guests will never forget. It’s current, contemporary and stylish, and it’s everything you’ve been dreaming about.
Simplify Meal Prep and Save Time

Five cooktop burners of varying sizes and power levels provide all the power and precision you need. From big pans to small pots, oblong cookware to oversize griddles, this cooktop has room for them all.
Elevate Your Cooking With Efficient Heat
A 24K BTU UltraHeat™ Dual Burner does it all—from quick boils and sautés to gentle simmers, so you can express yourself in the kitchen.

Specially-coated EasyClean® surface means memorable dinners will leave a mark on your guests, not on your cooktop. Spills and splatters wipe away in an instant to keep your stainless steel looking like new.

Keep the focus on your filet—these white LED backlit knobs immediately tell you when each burner is on or off with just a glance while adding a little bit of wow with every turn. Crafted from metal for a substantial, pro-style feel.
Sync with Smart LG SIGNATURE Hoods and Microwaves

Sync your cooktop and smart LG SIGNATURE hood or over-the-range microwave via the LG ThinQ® app to automatically activate the fan and light when the cooktop burners are in use, for a seamless cooking experience.
